prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
sign_in, copy changes remain consistently helpful, winning 5 out of 7 tests (+2.8% average after noise correction).
adoption, redesign changes are helpful, winning 3 out of 5 tests (+3.1% average after noise correction), while 2 showed no clear effect.
home, wait_info changes are helpful, winning 2 out of 5 tests (+2.3% average after noise correction), though 3 showed no clear effect.
finish, new_screen changes failed to sustain early success, with 3 out of 4 tests showing no clear effect or performing worse (-1.3% average after noise correction).
home, new_flow, finish, redesign, choose_path, copy, sign_in, hint, finish, hint, home, notification, and adoption, layout changes consistently showed no clear effect or performed worse across multiple tests.
Predictions were overly optimistic for finish, new_screen, finish, redesign, and choose_path, copy changes, predicting positive gains where actual results were mostly negative or had no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, copy] Persistent Pet Account Sync Copy: Display explicit copy reassuring users that signing in safely saves their pet progress, state, and custom desktop pets permanently. (why: Support mail received 8 complaints about pets missing or reset after signing in; sign_in copy changes have a strong winning track record (+2.8% average gain).)
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Trait Selector Companion Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a checklist layout featuring interactive trait cards and pet personality previews. (why: Redesign changes in adoption are historically successful (+3.1% average gain), and mean adoption time is long at 1017s.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Status Log Wait Info: Add estimated wait times and interactive engine initialization tips while preparing the desktop pet environment. (why: Home target step has high mean latency (2336s) and support received 3 issues regarding missing pets on desktop; wait_info changes average +2.3% gain.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Personality Diagnostic Flow: Insert a short personality quiz sub-flow during adoption to help users easily pick matching pet behaviors. (why: Big move in adoption; addresses 3 support complaints regarding custom pet generation failures/dissatisfaction by offering structured trait selection.)
4: [finish, layout] Checklist Layout Desktop Welcome Guide: Switch the onboarding finish screen to a clear checklist layout explaining key pet control shortcuts and tray menu options. (why: Finish conversion drops to 77.0% with massive mean time (5815s), and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide pets.)
5: [choose_path, redesign] Story Layout Path Selection Focus: Redesign the path selection screen into a story scroll layout highlighting the differences between instant adoption and custom pet creation. (why: Choose path screen has high mean completion time (514s); redesigning key selection screens helps set clear path expectations.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Multi-Session Account Retention Hint: Add a prominent hint below sign-in options clarifying that signing in protects pets across app updates and re-installs. (why: 8 support emails complained about lost pet data; sign_in copy and hint improvements consistently improve funnel conversion.)
7: [home, new_screen] Desktop Launch Verification Screen: Add a dedicated launch verification screen right before entering desktop mode to ensure display drivers and pet overlay render cleanly. (why: Big move in home step; 3 support tickets noted pet not rendering or app failing to launch during initial load.)
